verified_scope.AD-01: Settled actual HP loss from projectile, direct dart and aerial impact is attack damage; explicit externally adjudicated recipient is required.
verified_scope.AD-02: Settled violation-penalty HP loss on robot, base or outpost credits victim team opponent.
verified_scope.AD-03: Adjudicated ordinary armor collision and module offline loss on eligible robots is excluded from attack damage. Base/outpost versions are unsupported.
verified_scope.AD-06/AD-07: Inputs are already rounded settled integers; ledger does not reapply damage formulas, buffs, rounding or clamps.
verified_scope.AD-10/AD-11: Yellow-warning floor and red-card zero HP are upstream settlement responsibilities, not inferred from a generic penalty event.

engineering_contract: Nonnegative int64 time/HP/totals and consecutive uint64 sequence are interface choices, not official timing or sequence formats.
Ledger consumes one externally ordered/classified deduction, not gross HP movement with healing or several unresolved causes.
Every attack recipient is an explicit upstream adjudication. The ledger has no attacker field and does not infer friendly/unknown-source or moving-dart group credit.
Robot for armor collision/module offline additionally asserts upstream ground-robot applicability where the source requires it.
Batch application is atomic; same-time deductions are permitted only as externally settled facts. Repeated/gapped sequences and post-seal credits are rejected.
External settlement owns identity/HP continuity, trigger validity, rate limits, deduplication beyond sequence, official cutoff, and completeness. A valid fact is not proof of an official legal match.
No pre-match forfeit override, referee penalty generation, automatic damage classifier, healing, revival, multi-source overkill allocation or official event ordering is implemented.

integration.scope: Only tactical_mode uses an EXPERIMENTAL-reconciled-projectile-hp-loss-v1 adapter; older modes and formal match/capture modules are unchanged.
integration.native_gap: Native hit event amounts are nominal, carry no bullet ID and have no official referee cause or settlement validity metadata.
integration.adapter: Group opposing hits per victim per native tick, compare aggregate nominal damage and pre/post HP against the unchanged native zero clamp, then feed one explicitly experimental settled projectile fact. Never allocate overkill among individual hits.
integration.unknown: Any unsupported event/cause, HP-baseline drift or failed reconciliation permanently makes attack totals unavailable; partial observed totals cannot resolve an attack tiebreak.
integration.cutoff: The named experimental combat-damage-qualify-activate-capture-credit-judge-v2 order includes native damage on tick25200 before the420000ms judgment; this is not official referee settlement timing.
integration.privacy: Damage totals and surviving enemy HP stay administrative; no policy observation additions.
